name: sun397
description: SUN397 is a large-scale scene recognition dataset with 397 scene categories and tens of thousands of images, designed to evaluate models' ability to recognize diverse environments (indoor and outdoor). It measures general scene classification performance and robustness across many fine-grained categories and varied visual conditions. Commonly used to benchmark convolutional and transformer-based image classifiers on multiclass scene understanding.
reputation: A widely used, large-scale benchmark for scene classification that is well-known in the computer vision community for evaluating general scene recognition models.
